en.headline: Man, 57, found dead at Ping Tin Estate, reports say
en.dek: Hong Kong 01 and Sing Tao reported that staff found a man unconscious in a service building at about 9pm on Friday, and paramedics confirmed he had died.
body: A 57-year-old man was found dead on Friday night in a room at the service facilities building of Ping Tin Estate in Lam Tin, Hong Kong 01 and Sing Tao reported.

The reports said staff noticed a smell from the room at about 9pm and called for help, believing the man had collapsed. Firefighters forced the door, and ambulance crew confirmed he had died at the scene.

Police were investigating at the scene, the reports said. The cause of death had not been established and was awaiting a post-mortem. The reports said the man had a history of illness. No one had been arrested in connection with the case in the accounts published overnight.

zh.headline: 藍田平田邨服務大樓揭57歲男子死亡
zh.dek: 《香港01》及星島報道，周五晚約9時職員發現男子在服務設施大樓房間內暈倒，救護員到場證實不治。
body: 藍田平田邨服務設施大樓周五晚發生一宗死亡事件。《香港01》及星島報道，一名57歲男子被發現在大樓一個房間內，救護員到場後證實已經死亡。
報道指，職員約晚上9時察覺房間傳出異味，懷疑男子在內暈倒，遂報案。消防員到場後破門進入，救護員檢查後證實男子當場不治。
報道稱，警員在現場調查，死因有待驗屍確定，又指事主有身體病紀錄。已公布的報道未提及有人因案件被捕。
